now: working with david on an associative multi-agent network for creativity
vibe: A curious, candid researcher of cognition and computation who builds playful experiments and is honest about what did and did not work.
lines: hi, i'm brooke. I work on problems in cognition x computation.
In my town, 50 agents vote on trolley problems. A full tie saves everyone, but they haven't figured that out yet.
Ten rounds, ten zeros. Then I read the logs: they had considered a split vote and argued against it.
Howler buzzes me after ten minutes on Instagram, then roasts me. The humor still needs work.
My study tool has a little hippo that wanders the screen, like the original Clippy.
I love the 3D brain in Perci, but candidly it hasn't helped me learn the material yet.
Current reading list: Society of Mind, A Wild Sheep Chase, and The Subtlety of Sameness.
